 Navigate differences in compensation norms, notice periods, employment models, and candidate expectations with Legal, Compensation, and People partners. 
 Embed diversity, equity, and inclusion into recruiting processes and hiring decisions. 
 Manage a personal requisition load when needed, focusing on senior and specialized Sales roles such as country leaders, front-line managers, and technical sales talent. 
 Use recruiting data to track team performance, identify bottlenecks, and improve hiring strategies and candidate experience across the APJ Sales portfolio. 
 Partner with Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Enablement, People Business Partners, Compensation, and Finance on workforce planning and coordinated candidate and stakeholder experiences.

 A systems-thinking approach to building scalable recruiting processes across varied Sales roles and local market requirements. 
 Ability to use data and analytics to shape recruiting strategy, identify gaps, and communicate impact to stakeholders.

 Commercial Named Account Executives are the primary point of contact between prospective and existing customers of GitLab within the top end of the mid-market, which currently works with companies that employ between 2,500 to 4,000 employees. These GitLab team members manage the spectrum of project sizes, ranging from small fast growing teams in smaller agile organizations to complex enterprise projects advising on the journey with GitLab to achieve specific business outcomes. 
 Commercial Named AEs work closely in tandem with the business development team and sales management to manage a broad book of business spread over a large opportunity value range and focus on exceeding client expectations.

  What you'll do  
 
 Meet or exceed quota while fostering strong customer relationships 
 Articulate the value of GitLab to our  Commercial  prospects and customers in the US Western region 
 Take ownership of and act as the CEO for the book of business in your territory: 
 
 Document the buying criteria & process, next steps & owners 
 Build a strong pipeline through a healthy cadence of prospecting activity 
 Prospect and close new business to expand your territory 
 Ensure adoption of our solutions and do your best to avoid churn and contraction 
 Work and collaborate with our Partner ecosystem to drive new business and value for our customers 
 Create an accurate forecast for each quarter against your plan/budget 
 Drive attendance to our events, which you will be part of to further network with current and prospective customers

 Master MEDPICC and Command of the Message on all opportunities

 A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with GitLab

 Interest in GitLab, and open source software 
 Ability to leverage established relationships and proven sales techniques

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    An overview of this role 
 As a Senior Backend Engineer on Development Health, you'll help make the systems that engineering teams rely on more reliable, maintainable, and easier to extend. You'll build and improve the automation, tooling, and data that help teams spot problems early and ship with less friction. 
 As customer zero for GitLab, we support engineering workflows on GitLab's own product at scale. You'll use the product in demanding, real-world ways, surface the friction and gaps you find, and contribute to improvements that get built into the product for GitLab's customers. 
 You'll support work such as: 
 
 Health alerting and remediation routing for GitLab's core continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines 
 Flaky and slow test detection systems 
 Engineering analytics and reporting that engineering teams use to make decisions 
 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Own and evolve core Development Health systems, from design through production. 
 Improve the reliability, maintainability, and test coverage of long-lived automation, and reduce reliance on undocumented knowledge by documenting and simplifying legacy systems. 
 Partner with engineering managers and product teams to identify workflow pain points and turn them into well-scoped, measurable improvements. 
 Work with data to show whether changes improve engineering health, and use it to prioritize. 
 Mentor intermediate engineers through code review, design feedback, and pairing. 
 Communicate clearly in writing and asynchronously, including status, tradeoffs, and proposals for stakeholders across Engineering. 
 Monitor the health of production systems, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis. 
 Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and assistants to analyze issues and problem areas to help shape the team's product roadmap. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Substantial experience as a backend or tooling engineer, with a track record of owning production systems end to end. 
 Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly. 
 Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely. 
 Comfort with CI/CD systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation at scale. 
 Independent problem-solving and clear, concise written communication: you spot problems early, raise risks proactively, and drive work to completion without close direction. 
 Experience writing automated unit and integration tests and taking part in collaborative code review.

2.有AI 视频创作实战经验，能展示 AI 生成视频作品集；
3.具备扎实的内容策划与文案能力，理解 B 端用户的内容逻辑；
4.对短视频传播有系统性认知，熟悉主流平台算法与内容规律。

title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Engineering: Chat
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Duo Chat team, focused on Chat Engine, you'll build the core AI capabilities behind GitLab Duo Chat, the natural-language and agentic interface to the GitLab DevSecOps platform. Much of your work will involve building flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry, the Python framework built on LangGraph within our Duo Workflow Service that powers agentic chat, and integrating them with the GitLab Rails monolith. 
 You'll own complex backend features from start to finish across both services. You'll integrate large language models and orchestrate multi-agent flows so customers can work faster and more securely across the software development lifecycle. This work sits where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy, and reliability, performance, and answer quality directly shape the customer experience. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Design and build flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry using Python and LangGraph within the Duo Workflow Service. These reusable building blocks power agentic Duo Chat and, increasingly, other AI features across GitLab. 
 Develop, ship, and maintain backend features for GitLab Duo Chat across the Python Duo Workflow Service and the GitLab Rails monolith in a secure, well-tested, and performant way. 
 Integrate new generative AI models, providers, tools, and multi-agent orchestration patterns into Duo Chat to expand its capabilities and improve answer quality. 
 Design, implement, and review GraphQL and Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs) and related monolith logic, including chat entry points, permissions, and foundational-flow registration. Keep contracts with frontend clients and host systems reliable and clear. 
 Improve debugging, observability, and test coverage using pytest, RSpec, and related frameworks; track and improve latency, error rates, and test coverage so AI-powered chat workflows stay reliable at scale. 
 Collaborate with Product, User Experience (UX), frontend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality improvements through iteration. 
 Document standards, patterns, and learnings with other engineers, raising the bar for safe AI integration and evidence-driven engineering. 
 Participate in Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and strengthen resiliency. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Significant experience building and maintaining production Python backends, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workloads.

-设计并落地线索转化路径（内容触达 → 留资 → 分发 → 跟进），与招商团队协同，提升线索到商机的转化率。
2. 新媒体运营：
-负责面向商家/品牌方/合作商等目标客群的新媒体账号运营，制定内容规划并落地执行；
-策划行业洞察、招商政策解读、成功案例等内容专题，建立品牌在招商侧的影响力与信任感；
-监测内容数据与线索归因，迭代内容策略与投放策略。
3. 运营增长：
-基于数据驱动，设计并实验线索增长玩法（裂变活动、私域运营、直播招商会、异业合作等）；
-搭建招商线索数据看板，定期复盘渠道 ROI，优化预算与人力投放；
-探索新的获客渠道与增长模式，形成可复制的方法论。 1. 本科及以上学历，3年以上运营相关经验，有招商、加盟、B端获客或线索增长经验者优先；

3. 具备运营增长思维，熟悉 A/B 测试、漏斗分析、私域运营等增长方法论，数据敏感度高；
4. 优秀的跨团队协作与推动能力，能与招商、销售、市场团队高效配合；
5. 加分项：有本地生活、零售连锁、商业地产等行业资源或招商经验。

  An overview of this role  
 As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll be a key partner to Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting leadership, helping them execute hiring plans, coordinate interviews, and maintain accurate, transparent processes in our applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles. You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment. 
  What You’ll Do    
 
 Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition. 
 Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. 
 Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly. 
 Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process. 
 Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team. 
 Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters. 
 Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab. 
 Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members. 
 
  What You’ll Bring   
 
 Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment. 
 Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required. 
 Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools. 
 Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives

title: Tech Operations Specialist
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 The Tech Operations Specialist keeps the field organization's AI tooling running smoothly day to day. You will maintain a clear inventory of AI tools in use across the field, manage an index of use cases and field needs, track adoption and utilization, manage access requests, and keep the underlying data feeding these tools clean and well-organized. This is a detail-oriented, execution-focused role for someone who enjoys bringing order to a fast-moving tool landscape and wants to build a foundation in Tech operations. 
 This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI. 
  What You’ll Do    
 
  Tool Inventory & Consolidation:  Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all AI tools used across the field org, identify overlap or redundancy, and support consolidation efforts to reduce tool sprawl.

  Utilization & Tracking:  Monitor usage of AI tools across teams, build simple reporting to track adoption trends, and flag underutilized or underperforming tools to stakeholders. 
  Comms & Enablement:  draft internal announcements for tool rollouts and create micro-enablement programs to engage the field in AI tools. 
  Tool Access Requests/Management:  Own the intake and processing of access requests for AI tools, ensuring provisioning is timely, accurate, and aligned with licensing and approval requirements. 
  AI Data Management:  Support the organization, quality, and hygiene of data used by or generated from AI tools, working with relevant teams to keep gDrive/datasets accurate and properly maintained.

title: 资深动作设计师（大话端游）
jd_text:
1、良好的动画设计基础，对动画镜头运镜有一定的了解。对于人形、非人形的肢体动作、运动节奏有较强的理解能力；
2、想象力丰富，有很好的动作设计能力，展现流畅.生动的动作效果；
3、有良好的团队合作意识，易沟通协作；
4、对动作游戏比较熟悉，对游戏动作打击感有较深的理解；
5、具备3-5年以上大型游戏动作设计经验。 1、参与具体动作设计任务，审核外包提交的动作资源；
2、负责设计游戏中的角色的动作，对游戏角色的运动规律有深入的分析了解和制作经验；
3、需要与主美紧密合作，定游戏动作风格，输出动作设计模版和规范；
4、理具备良好的语言表达能力及合作态度，进行整流程环节配合，完成产品的美术效果实现。

title: 高级动作设计师（FPS-1）
jd_text:
1、5年以上3D动作设计经验，3年以上FPS/TPS项目经验，有写实军事或生存竞技类项目完整上线经历。熟练使用3ds Max/Maya、Motion Builder，深度掌握UE5动画系统或同类引擎工具。
2、对人体动态、枪械运作、战术动作有扎实的理解，能通过细微的节奏差异区分不同枪械的手感风格。具备动捕棚拍经验者优先。
3、熟悉第一人称武器抖动系统，有程序化动画或表情捕捉落地经验者优先。是萤火突击、塔科夫等写实射击游戏深度玩家更佳。
4、对写实手感有较高要求，注重动作细节与性能消耗的平衡，能接受反复调优与迭代。具备良好的跨部门沟通习惯，不局限于单一职能视角。 1、负责游戏中第一人称/第三人称枪械动作及战术动作的设计制作，包括换弹、滑铲、跨越、检视等，确保手感真实、节奏流畅。
2、制定写实动作的制作品质标准，规范资源输出格式，统筹外包团队的动作资产，确保多角色、多枪械的动作风格统一。
3、配合程序与TA优化受击反馈、镜头震动、物理挂件表现，通过动画细节强化射击打击感和战术沉浸感。
4、参与互动类动作的创新设计，如武器改装状态下的动态检视、负重状态的角色姿态变化、地形自适应翻越等，丰富战场表现力。

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure. 
 This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams. 
 We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working. 
   Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United States and Canada only. Candidates based in the United Kingdom can apply to this posting:   Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — UK (Intermediate to Senior Staff)   
  How our SRE hiring works  
 Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team. 
 
  Recruiter Screen:  A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction. 
  Core Technical:  The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review. 
  Hiring Manager Interview:  A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab. 
  Peer Technical:  Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on. 
  Skip-Level Interview:  A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams. 
 
 After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.

You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them.  You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.

 Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service 
 Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design

title: 腾讯云-服务器硬件高级工程师
jd_text:
1.主导腾讯云自研服务器（通用计算/Agentic AI/自研板卡）的硬件架构设计，包括主板、背板、电源、散热及互连拓扑等子系统的定义与优化；
2.负责面向云场景的PCIe板卡（如智能网卡、存储压缩卡等）硬件设计与研发，满足高性能计算与存储需求；
3.基于业务负载特性（计算/存储/网络）进行器件选型与方案权衡，输出完整的架构规格书与设计需求文档；
4.跟踪CPU、内存、PCIe/CXL、NIC、NVMe等关键器件的技术演进，推动LPDDR6、PCIe 6.0/7.0、CXL、液冷等新技术的预研与落地；
5.完成原理图与PCB Layout设计及评审，主导信号完整性(SI)和电源完整性(PI)的设计与优化；
6.设计供电(VRM/PDB)、时钟、复位、BMC/带外管理等核心电路，完成关键器件选型与参数验证；
7.制定硬件测试验证计划，主导EVT/DVT/PVT各阶段调试，解决硬件设计缺陷与验证问题；
8.执行信号完整性、电源质量、可靠性（HALT/HASS/高低温/振动）等全维度测试验证；
9.协同结构与热设计团队，完成风冷/液冷散热方案及机械结构的适配与优化；
10.与软件/固件（BIOS/BMC/OS/FPGA）、数据中心基础设施、采购供应链团队深度协作；
11.支持现网硬件故障分析(FA)、根因定位及改进方案落地，降低现网故障率。

title: 供应链采购经理（L3物料方向）-基础设施
jd_text:
1、负责数据中心硬件设备下阶物料品类采购供应商寻源、选择、合同谈判、价格谈判、资质评估，风险管理；
2、深入了解市场趋势及行业生态，拓展、维护合作伙伴关系，根据业务需求制定采购策略；
3、挖掘供应商生态协作能力，协调内外部资源，建立与供应商稳定的合作关系，保障供应持续性。

title: AI高级视觉设计师
jd_text:
1、拥有5年以上视觉设计经验，有互联网产品、营销活动设计经验，拥有大型成功案例可作为加分项。
2、具备扎实的视觉设计能力，熟悉版式、色彩、构图及视觉表达。
3、有大促活动或产品功能上新设计经验，能独立完成创意及多渠道物料延展。
4、AI 使用能力强，熟悉 AI 图像、视频或动画工具，并能应用于实际项目。
5、熟练使用 AE，能独立完成常见动效制作、合成及视频输出。
6、沟通协作能力和抗压能力强，能适应多项目并行及紧凑排期。 1、负责运营大促及营销活动的视觉设计工作，包括主 KV、长图、活动图等。
2、负责有道词典、Hi Echo 等新品及功能上新的宣传素材设计。
3、根据不同渠道和推广场景，完成线上运营及产品宣传物料的设计与延展。
4、制作新功能视频素材，涵盖创意构思、AI 动画、素材处理及视频输出。
5、使用 AE 完成产品功能演示、活动宣传等动效设计。
6、与产品、运营、市场等团队协作，推进设计落地，并按时交付。

title: 游戏资深UI设计师（CCG卡牌）-ZREO36工作室
jd_text:
团队介绍：ZERO36工作室旗下有《航海王热血航线》、《花亦山心之月》、《初音未来:缤纷舞台》多款游戏产品。
ZERO，是从0开始，是不畏过往，不惧将来；是回到原点，对知识诚实；是一切开始的基础。
36，如果加上°C，即为人体的温度，戒骄戒躁保持初衷，用""温度""拉齐大家的目标和价值观，做有温度的产品，有温度的运营，成为一个有温度的团队，欢迎加入我们！

1、参与一款科幻IP星球大战的CCG卡牌类游戏项目研发工作，主要负责UI模块；
2、根据游戏整体的美术风格和UI风格，与产品及策划、UX沟通，并根据UX进行UI各级界面的设计，整体把握项目UI的包装及设计；
3、与策划、程序及美术部门其他人员，推进并跟进设计效果最终在产品的落地实现，保证还原度品质；
4、有效管理和优化界面资源；
5、重视产品与用户体验，具有良好的分析问题与解决问题的能力；
6、整理外包需求文档，与外包反馈沟通并进行验收。

title: AI视频游戏策划（不问凡尘） - 江南工作室
jd_text:
团队介绍：江南游戏工作室成立于2019年初，我们立志于提供优质的游戏内容服务全球玩家。团队全力聚焦于高品质RPG/射击/AI/UGC游戏的产品研发与运营。欢迎热爱游戏的伙伴加入我们，为每位玩家带来有趣和激励人心的体验。

1、负责游戏系统和玩法的规划、设计、落地和迭代，探索AI视频表现与游戏交互结合的玩法体验；
2、作为功能负责人，利用AI工具独立完成功能Demo，把设计想法快速转化为可玩、可验证的原型，并结合实际体验持续推进功能优化；
3、关注产品细节和游戏节奏，持续打磨体验，确保负责的功能高品质落地；
4、依托AI视频引擎能力，持续探索AI时代的游戏开发流程与互动内容形式，打造令人惊艳的游戏体验。

title: 高级/资深场景原画（代号对决） - Bluesea Studio
jd_text:
团队介绍：Bluesea工作室成立于2024年8月，当前涉足卡牌/RPG/SLG/竞技等多个品类，已经上线的游戏《放置少女》，各类新产品已蓄势待发。欢迎加入我们！

1、负责场景关卡地图沙盘的规划设计；
2、负责场景气氛图的表现刻画；
3、负责场景单体三视图的设计与拆解；
4、负责场景建筑部件规则的拆分与组合；
5、负责场景原画外包沟通与品质把控。

title: 《王者荣耀世界》交互设计师-新星引力计划
jd_text:
1.负责跨平台游戏的交互设计工作，为常规需求提供快速有效解的决方案；
2.与策划、VX、GUI、程序、PM等职能紧密合作，共创界面与交互体验；
3.能独立完成拼接工作，全面跟进落地和验收，不断打磨改善体验，精益求精；
4.主动发现问题并采取行之有效的行动。

title: 魔方在研轻动作风格化游戏预研项目-高级动画师
jd_text:
1.负责项目的角色/生物等动画的设计与制作，确保动画效果符合项目需求与品质标准；
2.负责动画需求对接、动作方案设计、资源制作与交付，并主导动画资源在UE引擎中的合入、调试与最终效果验收，确保表现符合预期；
3.制定动画反馈标准与技术规范，进行动作质量审核、修改指导与交付验收，保障外部资源质量；
4.参与动画资源管理，优化动画性能，确保动画在移动端的流畅运行与合理资源占用；
5.持续关注行业动画技术趋势，探索创新动画表现手法，提升游戏整体动画表现力。

title: 《怪物猎人：旅人》-资深动画师-局内动画
jd_text:
1.负责写实方向的原创角色战斗技能设计与动画制作；
2.与策划，原画，特效等上下游环节一起进行角色的设计讨论与脑暴，输出角色动画表现创意；
3.与策划配合，进行高品质战斗动画手感联调；
4.善于工作沟通与协调,能在生产管线以及特性组中覆盖更多边界工作；
5.熟悉外包流程,把控外包制作的动画品质并负责最终入版效果。

title: 和平精英-资深游戏动画师（商业化）
jd_text:
1.负责商业化动画创意主导，把控整体氛围与视觉表现，贯穿从概念到落地的全链条；
2.独立完成动作设计与动捕精修，适配多动画风格；
3.与团队内部各环节（策划、原画、特效、场景等）高效沟通协作；
4.对接供应商，清晰传达需求与问题，管理外包团队确保交付质量；
5.持续研究新技术、新工具、新流程，引领团队前瞻性探索与创新。

title: 资深UI设计师（大话归来）
jd_text:
1. 专业背景  ▸ 硬门槛
· 美术相关专业本科及以上学历，具备扎实造型基础与系统美术训练
· 八大美院或同等艺术院校毕业优先  [优先]
· 具备手绘原创能力，速写、色彩、构图等美术基本功扎实，作品可体现系统学院派训练
◆ 2. 项目经验  ▸ 硬门槛
· 3–5 年游戏 GUI 设计经验，有完整项目从立项到上线的全程参与经历
· 必须有二次元项目上线经验（阴阳师、原神、崩铁、明日方舟、蓝档、少前、鸣潮等同类）  [必须]
· 有大型二次元项目 GUI 操刀经验/ 知名 IP / 头部发行）GUI 设计操刀经验，能展示核心模块设计案例  [优先]
· 有担任主设计师或主 GUI 推动项目视觉风格确立经历者更佳
◆ 3. 二次元浓度  ▸ 核心考察
· 美术底子扎实，手绘功底强，能独立完成原创角色/界面草稿，不依赖纯拼贴
· 熟练把控二次元视觉语言：造型夸张概括、色彩平涂、氛围塑造、中二感 / 萌系 / 末世感，至少一项有明确专长
· 拥有个人的视觉创意与设计语言，作品有辨识度，能感受到圈层文化积累
◆ 4. 设计思路  ▸ 核心考察
· 能清晰表达设计推导过程：信息层级、视觉重点、功能识别的设计逻辑
· 有独立主导产品视觉设计的能力，不止于执行
· 熟悉 UI 交互逻辑，善于优化界面布局与玩家操作体验
◆ 5. AI 能力  ▸ 硬门槛
· 必须熟练且深度掌握 AI 辅助设计工具（Midjourney / Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI / Firefly 等）  [必须]
· 能将 AI 高效融入设计全流程，实现效率与质量双提升，而非浅尝辄止
· 须提供实际 AI 辅助完成的设计案例，作为面试凭据
◆ 6. 工具能力
· Photoshop 精通
· AE / Spine / Figma / Illustrator 至少熟练 2 项
· 具备 3D、动画、特效或相关创新工具运用能力（加分）
◆ 7. 沟通与协作能力  ▸ 核心考察
· 具备清晰、主动的沟通能力：能准确表达设计意图，有效对齐策划、美术、程序等多方需求
· 具备良好的跨职能协作能力，能与 UX、美术、程序等上下游协同推进设计
· 具备内外包沟通与管控能力：精准传达设计标准、跟进修改意见、确保外包资源质量达标并顺利合入版本
· 遇到分歧能主动推动决策，而非被动等待
◆ 8. 行业认知
· 热爱游戏，深耕二次元品类，熟悉行业竞品
· 熟悉 ACGN 圈层文化，对二次元用户审美有独立见解 1.  视觉设计产出　负责游戏核心界面、图标、视觉素材及界面动效设计，把控整体二次元视觉风格统一，输出可落地的设计方案。
2.  设计模板与规范协助搭建　在美术风格明确前提下，协助制定 UI 设计模板、组件库与视觉规范，推进核心环节模块的设计与落地。
3.  跨职能协作与落地　与策划、UX、原画、特效、程序等上下游岗位协同推进设计工作，跟进开发还原，保证最终效果，关注游戏体验；能有效对齐多方需求、推动设计决策落地。
4.  内外包沟通与管控　负责外包 UI 资源的品质跟进，精准传达设计标准与修改意见，确保内外包团队目标一致、顺利合入版本；在内部团队与外部资源方之间高效协调沟通。
5.  AI 与工具效率　将 AI 设计工具深度融入日常工作流（必须项），结合 3D、动画、特效等创新工具运用，协助梳理 UI 设计流程，兼顾产出效率与画面质感。
6.  品类研究与视觉迭代　持续关注二次元品类竞品与行业前沿设计趋势，输出独立设计见解，支撑产品视觉迭代优化。
